title: pi-simple-sri observe event, format 1
description: One line of state/observe.jsonl: the append-only memory of the observer (episodes, judgements, observations, proposals and the answers of the user). A closed oneOf of ten events chosen by `type`; every level sets additionalProperties: false. src/observe/types.ts is the authority on the union and src/observe/store.ts reads tolerantly (a line this schema refuses is skipped and counted), so the negative cases live in test/unit/observe-event-schema.test.ts. A change of the shape or meaning of a field is a new format.

oneOf.description: Written once, by the first enabled cycle. Its `at` is the moment of opt-in: nothing older is read.
